items.title: Fred Minor Interview, 1961-11-01
items.q: The interviewee does not mention Terry; the interviewer states 'Terry is still living' and the interviewee does not respond with personal knowledge or connection.

ctx.x: Well, all of them during that time, like I said, was good and some of the fellas are still living now. Some of them are still living because they had the Tuxedo Band and they had the Imperial Band. And Lamb Farris had the Imperial Band. Yeah, they were still around. Some of them same old fellas are still around. Like Jim Crowe, he's still around. He worked with some of them. Tats still young. Tats.

Yeah. And the Imperial Band and the officer and the officer also. Terry is still living. He's still living. Isn't he? I don't know. I know his son is. I know his son teach school somewhere around here. Yeah.
There's anything you can tell us about Mr. Brown or?
